title: Faarfannaa Gaarreen Sochoose
intro: Seenaa gabricha Rabbii dinqisiisaa ta’e tokko saaxiluudhaaf jirta. Biyya ergamtootaa fi bulchitootaa keessatti fakkiin kun kitaaba waaqummaa, sagalee cimaa fi humna sibiilaa irra eebbifame. Yaadannoowwan sana yommuu dubbistu, kun eenyu taʼuu akka dandaʼu adda baasuu dandeessaa?
clues: Ani gabricha Rabbii kitaabni addaa naaf kenname ture.
Sagalee bareedaa qaba ture, galatni koos baayʼee jaallatamaa waan tureef tulluu fi simbirroonni illee natti makaman.
Lola beekamaa tokko irratti morkataa sodaachisaa taʼeen kan na mudate siʼa taʼu, xinnoo taʼus injifadheera.
Sibiilli akka naaf taʼu kan godhame siʼa taʼu, kunis harka kootiin meeshaa waraanaa akkan hojjedhu naaf heyyama ture.
Saba guddaa tokko irratti bulchaa akkan taʼu nan godhame, firdii irratti ogummaan koos beekamaa ture.
Ilmi koo innillee nabiyyii ta’eef qilleensaa fi jinnii to’achuun isaaf kenname.
arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
